subject: general
question: The ______ covers a wide range of activities from commerce, administration, transport, and financial and real estate activities, to business and personal services, education, health and social work.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tertiary Sector.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Tertiary Sector **is also known as the **Service Sector, **and it includes all the activities that** do not **involve the production of goods.
 
• This sector is mainly focused on providing services to** people and businesses**, such as** banking, healthcare, education, transportation, entertainment**, and more.
 
• The Tertiary Sector is the **fastest-growing sector** in most economies, and it plays a crucial role in the **development of a country's economy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mixed Sector **refers to an economy that has a combination of both **public and private ownership **of businesses and industries.
 
• **Secondary Sector** involves the production of goods by using** raw materials and transforming** them into finished products, such as **manufacturing, construction, and more.**
 
• **Primary Sector** involves the **extraction and production of raw materials** from natural resources, such as agriculture, mining, fishing, and more.
